---
title: "BRCA clock stability and QC"
author: "Pan-cancer aging pipeline"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: united
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    code_folding: hide
params:
  # One reader-facing report per TCGA–GTEx tissue pair
  tcga_project: "BRCA"
  gtex_project: "BREAST"

  # Feature set label used by upstream steps when writing RDS outputs
  feature_set: "PC"

  # Root directory containing step outputs: <out_root>/<TCGA>__<GTEx>/
  out_root: "results/derived/GTEx"

  # Minimum NAT samples required to treat the adjacent-normal cohort as present
  min_nat: 10

  # Figure output directory
  figure_dir: "results/figures/supplemental"
---

<!--
BRCA clock stability and QC (single TCGA–GTEx pair; defaults to BRCA–BREAST).

What this script produces (written to params$figure_dir)
- supplementary_brca_qc_pca.pdf: PCA of GTEx, adjacent-normal, and tumor samples in pathway ssGSEA space
- supplementary_brca_permuted_age_null.pdf: observed mean tumor deviation against the permuted-age null
- supplementary_brca_hyperparameter_stability_heatmap.pdf: mean ClockSHAP contributions across nearby (alpha, lambda) settings
- supplementary_brca_gtex_refit_bootstrap_coefficients.pdf: clock coefficient distributions across GTEx bootstrap refits
Some panels may not appear in the published manuscript. Panels are assembled and typeset in Adobe Illustrator.
The tumor bootstrap section (in B) and the coupling section (C) are not used in the manuscript; the tumor bootstrap PDF save is disabled.

Design intent
- Produce a single, reader-facing HTML report per cancer–tissue combination.
- Favor completeness and interpretability over runtime.
- Keep parameters minimal. Sections are skipped automatically when inputs or packages are missing.

Upstream assumptions
- Step 01 produced ssGSEA matrices + sample_metadata.
- Step 02 produced clock_and_RAA_objects (<analysis_id>/clock_and_RAA_objects-<feature_set>.rds).
- The ClockSHAP step (optional) produced clockshap_objects (<analysis_id>/clockshap_objects-<feature_set>.rds); if absent, a linear age-adjusted fallback is used.
- A coupling step (optional; not part of the manuscript or this repository) may have produced coupling_objects (<analysis_id>/coupling_objects-<feature_set>.rds). Section C is skipped when it is absent.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# ---- Report-wide constants (intentionally NOT parameters) ----
SEED <- 2026

# PCA/QC defaults
PCA_SCALE <- TRUE
PCA_N_PCS <- 10L
TOP_N_SHIFT_PATHS <- 25L

# Stability defaults
TOP_K_CONTRIB <- 15L
MAX_PT_FOR_HYPER <- 500L
MAX_HYPER_MODELS <- 9L

# Unified iteration budget (used for permutation + PT bootstrap + GTEx bootstrap refits)
N_ITER <- 1000L

# Hyperparameter neighborhood around tuned (alpha, lambda)
ALPHA_OFFSETS <- c(-0.25, 0, 0.25)
LAMBDA_MULTIPLIERS <- c(0.5, 1, 2)

set.seed(SEED)

# ---- Small helpers ----
reactable_pretty <- function(df, digits = 3) {
  if (!requireNamespace("reactable", quietly = TRUE)) return(df)
  df2 <- df %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., digits)))
  reactable::reactable(
    df2,
    searchable = TRUE,
    resizable = TRUE,
    striped = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 10
  )
}

safe_min <- function(x) if (length(x) && any(is.finite(x))) min(x, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
safe_med <- function(x) if (length(x) && any(is.finite(x))) stats::median(x, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
safe_max <- function(x) if (length(x) && any(is.finite(x))) max(x, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_

safe_cor <- function(x, y, method = "pearson") {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
  if (sum(ok) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  suppressWarnings(cor(x[ok], y[ok], method = method))
}

fit_slope <- function(y, age) {
  ok <- complete.cases(y, age)
  y <- as.numeric(y[ok])
  age <- as.numeric(age[ok])
  if (length(y) < 3) {
    return(tibble(n = length(y), intercept = NA_real_, slope = NA_real_, r2 = NA_real_))
  }
  fit <- lm(y ~ age)
  tibble(
    n = length(y),
    intercept = unname(coef(fit)[1]),
    slope     = unname(coef(fit)[2]),
    r2        = summary(fit)$r.squared
  )
}

cohens_d <- function(x1, x2) {
  x1 <- x1[is.finite(x1)]; x2 <- x2[is.finite(x2)]
  if (length(x1) < 2 || length(x2) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  m1 <- mean(x1); m2 <- mean(x2)
  s1 <- stats::var(x1); s2 <- stats::var(x2)
  sp <- sqrt(((length(x1)-1)*s1 + (length(x2)-1)*s2) / (length(x1)+length(x2)-2))
  if (!is.finite(sp) || sp == 0) return(NA_real_)
  (m2 - m1) / sp
}

topk <- function(x, k) {
  # x: named numeric
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(character())
  names(sort(abs(x), decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(k, length(x)))]
}

jaccard <- function(a, b) {
  a <- unique(a); b <- unique(b)
  if (!length(a) && !length(b)) return(NA_real_)
  length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
}
```

```{r figure_dir_setup, include=FALSE}
out_dir <- here::here(params$figure_dir)
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load_inputs, include=FALSE}
# Goal: load the step outputs for this TCGA–GTEx pair and harmonize cohorts
analysis_id <- paste0(params$tcga_project, "__", params$gtex_project)
proc_dir    <- file.path(here::here(params$out_root), analysis_id)
proc_dir_rel <- file.path(params$out_root, analysis_id)  # reader-facing (avoid absolute paths)
suffix      <- paste0("-", params$feature_set)

# --- Step 01: ssGSEA scores + metadata ---
scores_gtex <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, paste0("ssgsea_scores_gtex", suffix, ".rds")))
scores_nt   <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, paste0("ssgsea_scores_nt",   suffix, ".rds")))
scores_pt   <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, paste0("ssgsea_scores_pt",   suffix, ".rds")))
metadata    <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "sample_metadata.rds"))

# --- Step 02: clock outputs ---
clock_results <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, paste0("clock_and_RAA_objects", suffix, ".rds")))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rownames(metadata)))
stopifnot(all(colnames(scores_gtex) %in% rownames(metadata)))
stopifnot(all(colnames(scores_pt)   %in% rownames(metadata)))
stopifnot(all(colnames(scores_nt)   %in% rownames(metadata)))

feat <- clock_results$feature_names
stopifnot(all(feat %in% rownames(scores_gtex)))

# features matrices: samples × features (raw ssGSEA)
X_gtex <- t(scores_gtex[feat, , drop = FALSE])
X_nt   <- if (ncol(scores_nt) > 0) t(scores_nt[feat, , drop = FALSE]) else matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = length(feat), dimnames = list(NULL, feat))
X_pt   <- t(scores_pt  [feat, , drop = FALSE])

if (!identical(colnames(X_gtex), feat)) colnames(X_gtex) <- feat
if (!identical(colnames(X_pt),   feat)) colnames(X_pt)   <- feat
if (!identical(colnames(X_nt),   feat)) colnames(X_nt)   <- feat

# ages aligned to rownames
age_gtex <- metadata[rownames(X_gtex), "age_years"]
age_nt   <- if (nrow(X_nt) > 0) metadata[rownames(X_nt), "age_years"] else numeric()
age_pt   <- metadata[rownames(X_pt), "age_years"]

# Filter to samples with finite age (report should only use well-defined ages)
keep_g <- is.finite(age_gtex)
X_gtex <- X_gtex[keep_g, , drop = FALSE]
age_gtex <- as.numeric(age_gtex[keep_g])
names(age_gtex) <- rownames(X_gtex)

keep_pt <- is.finite(age_pt)
X_pt <- X_pt[keep_pt, , drop = FALSE]
age_pt <- as.numeric(age_pt[keep_pt])
names(age_pt) <- rownames(X_pt)

keep_nt <- if (length(age_nt)) is.finite(age_nt) else logical(0)
if (nrow(X_nt) > 0) {
  X_nt <- X_nt[keep_nt, , drop = FALSE]
  age_nt <- as.numeric(age_nt[keep_nt])
  names(age_nt) <- rownames(X_nt)
}

has_nat <- nrow(X_nt) >= as.integer(params$min_nat)

# ---- Compute GTEx expectation lines E[x_k | age] (linear) ----
# Goal: define a consistent "age-expected" baseline in GTEx for deviation calculations.
g0 <- g1 <- setNames(numeric(length(feat)), feat)
for (k in feat) {
  fit <- lm(X_gtex[, k] ~ age_gtex)
  g0[k] <- coef(fit)[1]
  g1[k] <- coef(fit)[2]
}

# ---- Baseline contribution matrix for tumors (phi) + deviation (preferred: ClockSHAP; fallback: linear age-adjusted) ----
# Goal: produce a stable baseline "contribution per pathway" matrix for PT, used by all stability checks.
clockshap_path <- file.path(proc_dir, paste0("clockshap_objects", suffix, ".rds"))
has_clockshap_file <- file.exists(clockshap_path)

baseline_phi_source_used <- NA_character_
baseline_phi_mat <- NULL
baseline_dev <- NULL

# Record counts before any alignment (for transparency)
n_pt_before_phi_align <- nrow(X_pt)

if (has_clockshap_file && requireNamespace("ClockSHAP", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cs_obj <- readRDS(clockshap_path)
  if (!is.null(cs_obj$pt$phi) && !is.null(cs_obj$pt$deviation)) {
    baseline_phi_source_used <- "clockshap_objects"
    baseline_phi_mat <- cs_obj$pt$phi
    baseline_dev <- cs_obj$pt$deviation
  }
}

if (is.null(baseline_phi_mat) || is.null(baseline_dev)) {
  baseline_phi_source_used <- "linear_age_adjusted"

  cs <- clock_results$clock_cs
  beta_cs <- cs$beta[feat]
  mu <- cs$mu[feat]
  sigma <- cs$sigma[feat]

  Exp_pt <- outer(as.numeric(age_pt), g1) + matrix(g0, nrow = nrow(X_pt), ncol = length(feat), byrow = TRUE)
  colnames(Exp_pt) <- feat

  Zadj <- (X_pt - Exp_pt)
  Zadj <- sweep(Zadj, 2, sigma, "/")
  baseline_phi_mat <- sweep(Zadj, 2, beta_cs, "*")

  # expected prediction under E[x|Age]
  Exp_z <- sweep(Exp_pt, 2, mu, "-")
  Exp_z <- sweep(Exp_z, 2, sigma, "/")
  exp_pred <- as.numeric(cs$alpha + Exp_z %*% beta_cs)

  # align to available tumor predictions
  pred_pt <- clock_results$pred$Tumour
  pred_pt <- pred_pt[intersect(rownames(X_pt), names(pred_pt))]
  pred_pt <- as.numeric(pred_pt[rownames(X_pt)])
  baseline_dev <- pred_pt - exp_pred
}

# Harmonize tumor sample IDs between X_pt and baseline_phi_mat if needed
common_pt <- intersect(rownames(X_pt), rownames(baseline_phi_mat))
if (length(common_pt) < 3) stop("Tumor samples do not overlap between X_pt and baseline contributions; check upstream outputs.")
if (!identical(rownames(X_pt), rownames(baseline_phi_mat))) {
  X_pt <- X_pt[common_pt, , drop = FALSE]
  age_pt <- age_pt[common_pt]
  baseline_phi_mat <- baseline_phi_mat[common_pt, , drop = FALSE]
  baseline_dev <- baseline_dev[common_pt]
}

colnames(baseline_phi_mat) <- feat
baseline_dev <- as.numeric(baseline_dev)
names(baseline_dev) <- rownames(baseline_phi_mat)

baseline_invariant_max_abs_err <- max(abs(rowSums(baseline_phi_mat) - baseline_dev), na.rm = TRUE)
n_pt_after_phi_align <- nrow(X_pt)

# Baseline summary used throughout the report
baseline_phi_summary <- tibble(
  feature = colnames(baseline_phi_mat),
  mean_phi = colMeans(baseline_phi_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_abs_phi = colMeans(abs(baseline_phi_mat), na.rm = TRUE),
  sd_phi = apply(baseline_phi_mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_phi))
```

## Cohort context

This report summarizes **QC, cohort shift, and stability** checks for a single pair:

- **TCGA tumor cohort:** `r params$tcga_project`
- **GTEx tissue cohort:** `r params$gtex_project`
- **Feature set:** `r params$feature_set`
- **Output directory:** `r proc_dir_rel`

---

# A) Cohort shift and QC

**Goal:** Identify gross **batch effects / cohort shifts** between GTEx normals, TCGA adjacent normals (if present), and TCGA tumors using ssGSEA pathway space.

## Age coverage

**Goal:** Confirm basic age coverage and sample sizes; large age-range differences can affect calibration and deviation estimates.

```{r age_summary, include=FALSE}
age_summ <- bind_rows(
  tibble(cohort = "GTEx",    n = sum(is.finite(age_gtex)), min = safe_min(age_gtex), med = safe_med(age_gtex), max = safe_max(age_gtex)),
  tibble(cohort = "TCGA-PT", n = sum(is.finite(age_pt)),   min = safe_min(age_pt),   med = safe_med(age_pt),   max = safe_max(age_pt)),
  tibble(cohort = "TCGA-AN", n = sum(is.finite(age_nt)),   min = safe_min(age_nt),   med = safe_med(age_nt),   max = safe_max(age_nt))
) %>%
  mutate(across(c(min, med, max), ~ signif(., 4)))
```

```{r age_summary_table}
reactable_pretty(age_summ)
```

## PCA in pathway space

**Goal:** Visualize the largest axes of variation to quickly surface issues like tissue mismatch, strong batch effects, or tumors separating along a dominant technical axis.

```{r pca_compute, include=FALSE}
cohort_tbl <- bind_rows(
  tibble(sample_id = rownames(X_gtex), cohort = "GTEx"),
  tibble(sample_id = rownames(X_pt),   cohort = "TCGA-PT"),
  tibble(sample_id = rownames(X_nt),   cohort = "TCGA-AN")
) %>%
  filter(!(cohort == "TCGA-AN" & !has_nat))

X_all <- bind_rows(
  as_tibble(X_gtex) %>% mutate(sample_id = rownames(X_gtex)),
  as_tibble(X_pt)   %>% mutate(sample_id = rownames(X_pt)),
  as_tibble(X_nt)   %>% mutate(sample_id = rownames(X_nt))
) %>%
  inner_join(cohort_tbl, by = "sample_id")

X_mat <- X_all %>%
  select(all_of(feat)) %>%
  as.matrix()

pca <- prcomp(X_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = PCA_SCALE)
pcs <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
pcs$sample_id <- X_all$sample_id
pcs$cohort <- factor(X_all$cohort, levels = c("GTEx", "TCGA-AN", "TCGA-PT"))

p_pca <- ggplot(pcs, aes(PC1, PC2, color = cohort)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 1.8) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", signif(100 * (pca$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)), 3), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", signif(100 * (pca$sdev[2]^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)), 3), "%)"),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
  )
```

```{r pca_plot}
p_pca
```

```{r pca_plot_save}
out_file <- file.path(out_dir, "supplementary_brca_qc_pca.pdf")
ggsave(
  filename = out_file,
  plot = p_pca,
  width = 185 / 25.4,
  height = 130 / 25.4,
  units = "in"
)
message("Saved: ", out_file)
```

## PC-space distances and dispersion

**Goal:** Quantify separation between cohorts (centroid distances) and internal heterogeneity (mean distance to centroid), complementing the PCA scatter.

```{r pca_metrics_compute, include=FALSE}
pca_metrics <- NULL
centroid_distances_tbl <- NULL

n_pcs <- max(2L, min(as.integer(PCA_N_PCS), ncol(pca$x)))
Z <- pca$x[, seq_len(n_pcs), drop = FALSE]
dfZ <- as.data.frame(Z)
dfZ$cohort <- X_all$cohort

centroids <- dfZ %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("PC"), mean), .groups = "drop")

pc_cols <- paste0("PC", seq_len(n_pcs))

# Within-cohort dispersion
disp <- bind_rows(lapply(unique(dfZ$cohort), function(co) {
  D <- as.matrix(dfZ[dfZ$cohort == co, pc_cols, drop = FALSE])
  cen <- unlist(centroids[centroids$cohort == co, pc_cols], use.names = FALSE)
  tibble(
    cohort = co,
    mean_dist_to_centroid = mean(sqrt(rowSums((D - matrix(cen, nrow(D), ncol(D), byrow = TRUE))^2)))
  )
}))

# Between-cohort centroid distances
cen_mat <- as.matrix(centroids %>% select(starts_with("PC")))
rownames(cen_mat) <- centroids$cohort
dist_mat <- as.matrix(stats::dist(cen_mat))

pairs <- expand.grid(from = rownames(dist_mat), to = colnames(dist_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  filter(from < to) %>%
  mutate(dist = dist_mat[cbind(from, to)])

pca_metrics <- pairs %>%
  left_join(disp, by = c("from" = "cohort")) %>% rename(from_disp = mean_dist_to_centroid) %>%
  left_join(disp, by = c("to" = "cohort")) %>% rename(to_disp = mean_dist_to_centroid) %>%
  mutate(dist = signif(dist, 4), from_disp = signif(from_disp, 4), to_disp = signif(to_disp, 4))

# Convenience summary table for the main three distances (when NAT present)
centroid_distances_tbl <- pca_metrics %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(from, "vs", to)) %>%
  select(pair, dist) %>%
  arrange(desc(dist))
```

```{r pca_metrics_table}
reactable_pretty(pca_metrics)
```

## Pathway-level cohort shifts

**Goal:** Identify pathways with the largest cohort-level shifts (Cohen’s d), which often explain cohort separation in PCA.

```{r shift_compute, include=FALSE}
shift_tbl <- tibble(
  pathway = feat,
  d_nat_vs_gtex = if (has_nat) vapply(feat, function(p) cohens_d(X_gtex[, p], X_nt[, p]), numeric(1)) else NA_real_,
  d_pt_vs_gtex  = vapply(feat, function(p) cohens_d(X_gtex[, p], X_pt[, p]), numeric(1)),
  d_pt_vs_nat   = if (has_nat) vapply(feat, function(p) cohens_d(X_nt[, p], X_pt[, p]), numeric(1)) else NA_real_
) %>%
  mutate(
    abs_d_pt_vs_gtex  = abs(d_pt_vs_gtex),
    abs_d_nat_vs_gtex = abs(d_nat_vs_gtex)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_d_pt_vs_gtex))
```

```{r shift_table}
reactable_pretty(
  shift_tbl %>%
    select(pathway, d_pt_vs_gtex, d_nat_vs_gtex, d_pt_vs_nat) %>%
    slice_head(n = TOP_N_SHIFT_PATHS)
)
```

# B) Contribution and clock stability

**Goal:** Check that the reported top contributing pathways are **not brittle** to (i) tuning choices, and (ii) sampling variation in the tumor cohort.

## Baseline contribution source

**Goal:** Make the “baseline contribution matrix” explicit, including which source was used and whether the $\sum_k \phi_{ik} = deviation_i$ invariant holds.

```{r baseline_source_compute, include=FALSE}
baseline_source_tbl <- tibble(
  quantity = c(
    "baseline phi source",
    "PT samples (before alignment)",
    "PT samples (after alignment)",
    "max |rowSums(phi) - deviation|"
  ),
  value = c(
    baseline_phi_source_used,
    n_pt_before_phi_align,
    n_pt_after_phi_align,
    signif(baseline_invariant_max_abs_err, 6)
  )
)
```

```{r baseline_source_table}
reactable_pretty(baseline_source_tbl)
```

### Baseline top contributors

**Goal:** Provide an interpretable “headline” ranking of pathways driving tumor deviation (mean |φ| across tumors).

```{r baseline_top_table}
reactable_pretty(baseline_phi_summary %>% slice_head(n = 25))
```

## Permuted-age null

**Goal:** Refit the same clock form on GTEx after *permuting ages* (destroying age signal), then compute the PT deviation under the permuted model.  
If the observed PT deviation is extreme relative to this null, it supports the deviation reflecting a real aging signal rather than purely model structure or cohort shift.

```{r permuted_age_compute, include=FALSE}
perm_tbl <- NULL
perm_summary <- NULL
p_perm <- NULL

if (requireNamespace("glmnet", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # Delta matrices (feature deviation from age-expected profile)
  Exp_pt <- outer(as.numeric(age_pt), g1) + matrix(g0, nrow = nrow(X_pt), ncol = length(feat), byrow = TRUE)
  colnames(Exp_pt) <- feat
  Delta_pt <- X_pt - Exp_pt

  Delta_nt <- NULL
  if (has_nat) {
    Exp_nt <- outer(as.numeric(age_nt), g1) + matrix(g0, nrow = nrow(X_nt), ncol = length(feat), byrow = TRUE)
    colnames(Exp_nt) <- feat
    Delta_nt <- X_nt - Exp_nt
  }

  obs_mean_pt <- mean(baseline_dev, na.rm = TRUE)
  obs_med_pt  <- median(baseline_dev, na.rm = TRUE)

  cs <- clock_results$clock_cs
  b_ref <- (cs$beta[feat] / cs$sigma[feat])
  dev_nt_ref <- if (!is.null(Delta_nt)) as.numeric(Delta_nt %*% b_ref) else NULL
  obs_mean_delta_pt_minus_nt <- if (!is.null(dev_nt_ref)) obs_mean_pt - mean(dev_nt_ref, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_

  n_perm_target <- as.integer(N_ITER)

  best_alpha  <- as.numeric(clock_results$tuning$best_alpha)
  best_lambda <- as.numeric(clock_results$tuning$best_lambda)

  set.seed(SEED + 310)
  out <- vector("list", n_perm_target)

  for (b in seq_len(n_perm_target)) {
    y_perm <- sample(age_gtex)

    fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
      x = X_gtex, y = y_perm,
      alpha = best_alpha,
      lambda = best_lambda,
      standardize = TRUE,
      intercept = TRUE
    )

    cm <- as.matrix(stats::coef(fit, s = best_lambda))
    b_orig <- setNames(as.numeric(cm[-1, 1]), rownames(cm)[-1])[feat]
    b_orig[is.na(b_orig)] <- 0

    dev_pt_perm <- as.numeric(Delta_pt %*% b_orig)
    mean_pt_perm <- mean(dev_pt_perm, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_pt_perm  <- median(dev_pt_perm, na.rm = TRUE)

    mean_delta_perm <- NA_real_
    if (!is.null(Delta_nt)) {
      dev_nt_perm <- as.numeric(Delta_nt %*% b_orig)
      mean_delta_perm <- mean_pt_perm - mean(dev_nt_perm, na.rm = TRUE)
    }

    out[[b]] <- tibble(
      iter = b,
      mean_dev_pt = mean_pt_perm,
      med_dev_pt  = med_pt_perm,
      mean_delta_pt_minus_nt = mean_delta_perm
    )
  }

  perm_tbl <- bind_rows(out)

  # Empirical p-values (two-sided)
  p_mean_pt <- (1 + sum(abs(perm_tbl$mean_dev_pt) >= abs(obs_mean_pt), na.rm = TRUE)) / (nrow(perm_tbl) + 1)
  p_med_pt  <- (1 + sum(abs(perm_tbl$med_dev_pt)  >= abs(obs_med_pt),  na.rm = TRUE)) / (nrow(perm_tbl) + 1)

  perm_summary <- tibble(
    metric = c("PT mean deviation", "PT median deviation", if (has_nat) "PT–AN mean deviation (delta)" else NULL),
    observed = c(obs_mean_pt, obs_med_pt, if (has_nat) obs_mean_delta_pt_minus_nt else NULL),
    null_mean = c(
      mean(perm_tbl$mean_dev_pt, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(perm_tbl$med_dev_pt,  na.rm = TRUE),
      if (has_nat) mean(perm_tbl$mean_delta_pt_minus_nt, na.rm = TRUE) else NULL
    ),
    null_sd   = c(
      sd(perm_tbl$mean_dev_pt, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd(perm_tbl$med_dev_pt,  na.rm = TRUE),
      if (has_nat) sd(perm_tbl$mean_delta_pt_minus_nt, na.rm = TRUE) else NULL
    ),
    empirical_p = c(
      p_mean_pt,
      p_med_pt,
      if (has_nat) (1 + sum(abs(perm_tbl$mean_delta_pt_minus_nt) >= abs(obs_mean_delta_pt_minus_nt), na.rm = TRUE)) / (nrow(perm_tbl) + 1) else NULL
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 5)))

  p_perm <- ggplot(perm_tbl, aes(x = mean_dev_pt)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 35) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = obs_mean_pt, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    labs(
      x = "Mean deviation (yr)",
      y = "Permuted refits"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
} else {
  perm_summary <- tibble(note = "glmnet is not available; permuted-age null check skipped.")
}
```

## Hyperparameter neighborhood stability

**Goal:** Refit clocks in a small neighborhood around the tuned $(\\alpha, \\lambda)$ and test whether the **rank and sign** of top contributors are stable.

```{r hyperparam_compute, include=FALSE}
hyper_overall_tbl <- NULL
hyper_feature_stability_tbl <- NULL
p_hyper_heatmap <- NULL

if (requireNamespace("glmnet", quietly = TRUE)) {
  mu_train <- clock_results$clock_cs$mu[feat]
  sigma_train <- clock_results$clock_cs$sigma[feat]

  # PT subsample keeps runtime bounded without changing the qualitative question
  set.seed(SEED + 10)
  pt_ids <- rownames(X_pt)
  if (length(pt_ids) > MAX_PT_FOR_HYPER) {
    pt_ids <- sample(pt_ids, size = MAX_PT_FOR_HYPER)
  }
  X_pt_sub <- X_pt[pt_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  age_pt_sub <- age_pt[pt_ids]

  Exp_sub <- outer(as.numeric(age_pt_sub), g1) + matrix(g0, nrow = nrow(X_pt_sub), ncol = length(feat), byrow = TRUE)
  colnames(Exp_sub) <- feat
  Zadj_sub <- sweep(X_pt_sub - Exp_sub, 2, sigma_train, "/")

  compute_meanphi <- function(beta_cs) {
    phi <- sweep(Zadj_sub, 2, beta_cs, "*")
    colMeans(phi, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  best_alpha <- as.numeric(clock_results$tuning$best_alpha)
  best_lambda <- as.numeric(clock_results$tuning$best_lambda)

  alpha_vals <- unique(signif(pmin(1, pmax(0, best_alpha + ALPHA_OFFSETS)), 4))
  lam_vals   <- unique(signif(best_lambda * LAMBDA_MULTIPLIERS, 6))

  grid <- expand.grid(alpha = alpha_vals, lambda = lam_vals, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (nrow(grid) > MAX_HYPER_MODELS) {
    set.seed(SEED + 11)
    grid <- grid[sample(seq_len(nrow(grid)), size = MAX_HYPER_MODELS), , drop = FALSE]
  }

  meanphi_list <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {
    a <- grid$alpha[i]
    lam <- grid$lambda[i]

    fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
      x = X_gtex, y = age_gtex,
      alpha = a,
      lambda = lam,
      standardize = TRUE,
      intercept = TRUE
    )

    coef_mat <- as.matrix(stats::coef(fit, s = lam))
    a_orig <- as.numeric(coef_mat[1, 1])
    b_orig <- setNames(as.numeric(coef_mat[-1, 1]), rownames(coef_mat)[-1])[feat]
    b_orig[is.na(b_orig)] <- 0

    beta_cs <- b_orig * sigma_train
    alpha_cs <- a_orig + sum(b_orig * mu_train, na.rm = TRUE)

    model_id <- sprintf("a=%.2f | lam=%.4g", a, lam)
    meanphi_list[[model_id]] <- compute_meanphi(beta_cs)
  }

  if (length(meanphi_list) >= 2) {
    meanphi_mat <- do.call(cbind, meanphi_list)
    colnames(meanphi_mat) <- names(meanphi_list)
    rownames(meanphi_mat) <- feat

    meanabs_mat <- abs(meanphi_mat)

    cor_mat <- suppressWarnings(cor(meanphi_mat, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
    cor_vals <- cor_mat[upper.tri(cor_mat)]

    base_top <- topk(setNames(baseline_phi_summary$mean_phi, baseline_phi_summary$feature), TOP_K_CONTRIB)
    top_j <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(meanphi_mat)), function(j) {
      jaccard(base_top, topk(meanphi_mat[, j], TOP_K_CONTRIB))
    }, numeric(1))
    names(top_j) <- colnames(meanphi_mat)

    hyper_overall_tbl <- tibble(
      n_models = ncol(meanphi_mat),
      spearman_meanphi_pairwise_med = median(cor_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      topk_jaccard_vs_baseline_med = median(top_j, na.rm = TRUE),
      topk_jaccard_vs_baseline_min = min(top_j, na.rm = TRUE),
      pt_subsample_n = nrow(X_pt_sub)
    ) %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4)))

    # Per-feature stability
    ranks <- apply(meanabs_mat, 2, function(x) rank(-x, ties.method = "average"))
    med_rank <- apply(ranks, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
    iqr_rank <- apply(ranks, 1, IQR, na.rm = TRUE)

    med_meanphi <- apply(meanphi_mat, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
    maj_sign <- ifelse(med_meanphi >= 0, 1, -1)
    sign_stab <- vapply(seq_along(feat), function(i) {
      x <- meanphi_mat[i, ]
      ok <- is.finite(x)
      if (sum(ok) == 0) return(NA_real_)
      mean(sign(x[ok]) == maj_sign[i])
    }, numeric(1))

    in_topk <- apply(ranks, 2, function(r) r <= TOP_K_CONTRIB)
    topk_freq <- rowMeans(in_topk, na.rm = TRUE)

    hyper_feature_stability_tbl <- tibble(
      feature = feat,
      baseline_mean_abs_phi = baseline_phi_summary$mean_abs_phi[match(feat, baseline_phi_summary$feature)],
      median_rank = med_rank,
      iqr_rank = iqr_rank,
      sign_stability = sign_stab,
      topk_freq = topk_freq,
      median_mean_phi = med_meanphi
    ) %>%
      arrange(median_rank) %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4)))

    # Heatmap across models for top baseline contributors
    top_paths <- baseline_phi_summary$feature[seq_len(min(TOP_K_CONTRIB, nrow(baseline_phi_summary)))]
    hm <- as.data.frame(meanphi_mat[top_paths, , drop = FALSE])
    hm$feature <- rownames(hm)
    hm_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(hm, cols = -feature, names_to = "model", values_to = "mean_phi")
    
    # symmetric limits so blue/red are balanced around zero
    phi_lim <- max(abs(hm_long$mean_phi), na.rm = TRUE)
    phi_lim <- if (is.finite(phi_lim)) phi_lim else 1
    
    p_hyper_heatmap <- ggplot(hm_long, aes(x = model, y = feature, fill = mean_phi)) +
      geom_tile() +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 13),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.key.height = unit(12, "pt"),
        plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
      ) +
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "blue3",
        mid = "white",
        high = "red3",
        midpoint = 0,
        limits = c(-phi_lim, phi_lim)
      ) +
      labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL,
        fill = "Mean ClockSHAP"
      )
  } else {
    hyper_overall_tbl <- tibble(note = "Insufficient hyperparameter models to summarize (need >=2).")
  }
} else {
  hyper_overall_tbl <- tibble(note = "glmnet is not available; hyperparameter stability skipped.")
}
```

## Tumor bootstrap stability (not used in the manuscript)

**Goal:** Resample tumor samples with replacement and recompute mean contributions. This tests whether the top contributors are stable to sampling variation in the tumor cohort. The PDF save for this plot is disabled.

```{r pt_boot_compute, include=FALSE}
boot_summary_tbl <- NULL
boot_feature_stability_tbl <- NULL
p_boot_freq <- NULL

phi <- baseline_phi_mat
nB <- as.integer(N_ITER)

feats <- colnames(phi)
meanphi_draws <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = length(feats),
  ncol = nB,
  dimnames = list(feats, paste0("boot", seq_len(nB)))
)

set.seed(SEED + 200)

for (jj in seq_len(nB)) {
  ix <- sample(seq_len(nrow(phi)), replace = TRUE)
  meanphi_draws[, jj] <- colMeans(phi[ix, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
}

B <- nB
cor_mat <- suppressWarnings(cor(meanphi_draws, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
cor_vals <- cor_mat[upper.tri(cor_mat)]

base_top <- topk(setNames(baseline_phi_summary$mean_phi, baseline_phi_summary$feature), TOP_K_CONTRIB)
jacc <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(meanphi_draws)), function(j) {
  jaccard(base_top, topk(meanphi_draws[, j], TOP_K_CONTRIB))
}, numeric(1))

boot_summary_tbl <- tibble(
  ran_n_boot = B,
  spearman_pairwise_med = median(cor_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
  topk_jaccard_vs_baseline_med = median(jacc, na.rm = TRUE),
  topk_jaccard_vs_baseline_min = min(jacc, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4)))

# Per-feature stability
med_meanphi <- apply(meanphi_draws, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
maj_sign <- ifelse(med_meanphi >= 0, 1, -1)
sign_stab <- vapply(seq_along(feats), function(i) {
  x <- meanphi_draws[i, ]
  ok <- is.finite(x)
  if (sum(ok) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(sign(x[ok]) == maj_sign[i])
}, numeric(1))

ranks <- apply(abs(meanphi_draws), 2, function(x) rank(-x, ties.method = "average"))
in_topk <- apply(ranks, 2, function(r) r <= TOP_K_CONTRIB)
topk_freq <- rowMeans(in_topk, na.rm = TRUE)

boot_feature_stability_tbl <- tibble(
  feature = feats,
  baseline_mean_abs_phi = baseline_phi_summary$mean_abs_phi[match(feats, baseline_phi_summary$feature)],
  sign_stability = sign_stab,
  topk_freq = topk_freq,
  median_mean_phi = med_meanphi
) %>%
  arrange(desc(baseline_mean_abs_phi)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4)))

plot_df <- boot_feature_stability_tbl %>%
  slice_head(n = min(25, nrow(.))) %>%
  mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = rev(feature)))

p_boot_freq <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = topk_freq, y = feature)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(
    x = "Top-k frequency",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
  )
```

## GTEx refit stability

**Goal:** Resample GTEx samples (with replacement), refit the clock at tuned hyperparameters, and check whether the **same pathways** and **directions** are consistently recovered.

```{r gtex_refboot_compute, include=FALSE}
refboot_summary_tbl <- NULL
refboot_feature_tbl <- NULL
p_refboot <- NULL

if (requireNamespace("glmnet", quietly = TRUE)) {
  best_alpha  <- as.numeric(clock_results$tuning$best_alpha)
  best_lambda <- as.numeric(clock_results$tuning$best_lambda)

  cs <- clock_results$clock_cs
  b_ref <- (cs$beta[feat] / cs$sigma[feat])
  b_ref[is.na(b_ref)] <- 0

  k <- max(10L, TOP_K_CONTRIB)
  top_feat <- names(sort(abs(b_ref), decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(k, length(b_ref)))]

  n_boot_target <- as.integer(N_ITER)
  coef_draws <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(feat), ncol = n_boot_target, dimnames = list(feat, paste0("boot", seq_len(n_boot_target))))

  set.seed(SEED + 410)

  for (b in seq_len(n_boot_target)) {
    ix <- sample(seq_len(nrow(X_gtex)), replace = TRUE)

    fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
      x = X_gtex[ix, , drop = FALSE],
      y = age_gtex[ix],
      alpha = best_alpha,
      lambda = best_lambda,
      standardize = TRUE,
      intercept = TRUE
    )

    cm <- as.matrix(stats::coef(fit, s = best_lambda))
    b_orig <- setNames(as.numeric(cm[-1, 1]), rownames(cm)[-1])[feat]
    b_orig[is.na(b_orig)] <- 0

    coef_draws[, b] <- b_orig
  }

  cor_mat <- suppressWarnings(cor(coef_draws[top_feat, , drop = FALSE], method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  cor_vals <- cor_mat[upper.tri(cor_mat)]

  base_top <- names(sort(abs(b_ref), decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(k, length(b_ref)))]
  jacc <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(coef_draws)), function(j) {
    top_j <- names(sort(abs(coef_draws[, j]), decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(k, nrow(coef_draws)))]
    jaccard(base_top, top_j)
  }, numeric(1))

  refboot_summary_tbl <- tibble(
    ran_n_boot = ncol(coef_draws),
    spearman_pairwise_med_topk = median(cor_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    topk_jaccard_vs_baseline_med = median(jacc, na.rm = TRUE),
    topk_jaccard_vs_baseline_min = min(jacc, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4)))

  eps <- 1e-12
  sel_freq <- rowMeans(abs(coef_draws) > eps, na.rm = TRUE)

  sign_ref <- sign(b_ref)
  sign_ref[sign_ref == 0] <- NA_integer_

  sign_stab_selected <- vapply(seq_along(feat), function(i) {
    x <- coef_draws[i, ]
    sel <- abs(x) > eps & is.finite(x)
    if (!any(sel) || is.na(sign_ref[i])) return(NA_real_)
    mean(sign(x[sel]) == sign_ref[i])
  }, numeric(1))

  refboot_feature_tbl <- tibble(
    feature = feat,
    baseline_coef = b_ref[feat],
    baseline_sign = sign_ref[feat],
    selection_freq = sel_freq,
    sign_stability_if_selected = sign_stab_selected,
    median_coef = apply(coef_draws, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_coef = apply(coef_draws, 1, IQR, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(baseline_coef))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 4)))

  # Boxplot of coefficient variability across bootstraps, highlighting pathways in the official clock.
  coef_df <- as.data.frame(coef_draws)
  coef_df$Pathway <- rownames(coef_draws)

  coef_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
    coef_df,
    cols = -Pathway,
    names_to = "Bootstrap",
    values_to = "Beta"
  )

  meds <- coef_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Pathway) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(median_beta = stats::median(Beta, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(median_beta)

  coef_long$Pathway <- factor(coef_long$Pathway, levels = meds$Pathway)

  official_paths <- names(b_ref)[abs(b_ref) > eps]
  coef_long <- coef_long %>%
    dplyr::mutate(in_official_clock = as.character(Pathway) %in% official_paths)
  
  p_refboot <- ggplot(
    coef_long,
    aes(x = Pathway, y = Beta, color = in_official_clock)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(`TRUE` = "red3", `FALSE` = "grey50"),
      breaks = c(TRUE, FALSE),
      labels = c("Retained in clock", "Not retained"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    ) +
    labs(
      y = "Clock coefficient",
      x = NULL
    )
} else {
  refboot_summary_tbl <- tibble(note = "glmnet is not available; GTEx bootstrap refits skipped.")
}
```

# C) Coupling stability summary (not used in the manuscript)

**Goal:** If a coupling step produced coupling bootstrap descriptors, import them here for a single “stability dashboard” view (no recomputation in this report). The coupling step is not part of the manuscript or this repository, so this section is normally skipped.

```{r coupling_import, include=FALSE}
coupling_bootstrap_tbl <- NULL
coupling_bootstrap_msg <- NULL

coupling_path <- file.path(proc_dir, paste0("coupling_objects", suffix, ".rds"))
if (file.exists(coupling_path)) {
  coup <- readRDS(coupling_path)
  if (!is.null(coup$bootstrap) && !is.null(coup$bootstrap$descriptors)) {
    coupling_bootstrap_tbl <- coup$bootstrap$descriptors
    coupling_bootstrap_msg <- "Imported coupling bootstrap summary from the coupling step outputs."
  } else {
    coupling_bootstrap_msg <- "Coupling objects found, but no bootstrap summaries present (run the coupling step with do_bootstrap=TRUE if needed)."
  }
} else {
  coupling_bootstrap_msg <- "No coupling bootstrap outputs found; skipping import."
}
```
